home.about_text: Ranaji Chhath Puja Park Samiti (Regd.) is a premier socio-cultural puja committee of the area, dedicated to the service of Chhathi Maiya for the past 10 consecutive years. The committee's mission is to organize Chhath Mahaparv with utmost devotion and foster social and cultural unity in the community.
